title: mail: SQLite migrations (users, subscriptions, user_flags)
description:
Create crates/mail/migrations/ with three tables: (1) users: id INTEGER PK, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL; (2) subscriptions: user_id INTEGER, group_name TEXT, subscribed_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, group_name); (3) user_flags: user_id INTEGER, article_cid BLOB, seen INTEGER DEFAULT 0, flagged INTEGER DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, article_cid). Add run_migrations(pool) using sqlx::migrate!

Why: per-user state must be schema-defined before any user-state or subscription logic is implemented.

Acceptance: migrations run cleanly on a fresh in-memory SQLite pool.
